name: duefold
description: Lightweight, modular, self-hosted investor data room

scripts.build: npm run compose && npm run build --workspace @duefold/web-client && node deploy/check-browser-budgets.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run compose && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web-client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p modules/branding-notifications/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/browser/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run compose && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:authz: npm run compose && vitest run --project authz
scripts.docs:screenshots: npm run build && playwright test --config test/screenshots/playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run compose:verify && npm run compose:verify:minimal && npm run compose && npm run test:unit
